title: Issue segmentation by public agencies: Assessing communication strategies of EU agencies related to Covid-19
descriptions: Replication material for the paper "Issue segmentation by public agencies: Assessing communication strategies of EU agencies related to Covid-19", published in Governance (by Moritz Müller & Bert Fraussen). For quick overview, please find .html file to see all outputs. For a replication on your own, you first need to download the full Tweet dataset via the Twitter API. Due to copyright regulations by Twitter, these files cannot be shared without access to the Twitter API. For further questions, please contact the authors.
